the CAF derived CDM is a dynamic and complex system that can be reprogrammed to render it tumor restrictive.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have discovered a novel and potentially therapeutic mechanism of desmoplasias anisotropy regulation by CAF derived CDMs, that is mediated via extracellular matrix stiffness and the extracellular signal regulated kinases, ERK1 and ERK2, in PDAC.
we found that CAF derived CDMs are highly dynamic and that their rigidity is a major determinant of the architecture of CAF derived CAF derived CDEs.

The main takeaway from our work is that
CDMs can have a tumor suppressive role and that CDMs could be reprogrammed to become tumor restrictive.
CDM rigidity, as opposed to its stiffness, controls its anisotropy.
